prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: Warwrit world-map party sprite, one square RGBA sprite on genuinely transparent background.
Input image 1 is the edit target, the existing party banner. Image 2 is the approved ink/flat-wash style reference only.
Primary request: fix the enormous flag relative to its three mercenaries. Keep exactly three anonymous rough-cloaked travelers and the same original dull oxblood flag with pale broken-circle-and-diamond sigil. Make the humans the primary readable silhouettes, standing closely around the pole; give each figure credible adult proportions. Shorten the pole to about 1.4 times a person's height above their shared footing, and make the cloth about half a person tall and 0.6 person wide. No giant banner, monument or pile of stones.
Preserve the target's serious grounded dark fantasy ink contours, matte flat washes, muted charcoal/umber/soot/oxblood palette, weathered timber and wool, light from upper left and existing three-quarter top-down projection (about 50 degrees). No cartoon faces, glossy or photorealistic render, bright colors, new faction symbols, scenery, text or watermark.
Composition: isolated complete compact group, square canvas, horizontal center of the three people's combined foot positions at x=50%, ground/contact pivot at y=82% of canvas. Natural tiny irregular earth contact only, no platform or tile. Leave transparent padding all around and keep all feet, pole and cloth intact. Preserve true transparency.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit only the flag and pole proportions in this transparent Warwrit sprite. Keep all three mercenaries, their faces, poses, materials, ground contacts, ink/flat-wash style, colors, three-quarter projection, lighting, overall square canvas and transparent padding unchanged. The pole is still too tall: SHORTEN its above-ground height to 1.4 times the center mercenary's standing height, about one-third shorter than now. Keep the pole bottom held by the center mercenary, shorten the upper section. The top tip should end around 37% of canvas height, just modestly above the three heads. Shrink the hanging oxblood cloth to about half of a standing mercenary's height and 0.6 of that height wide. Keep the same broken-circle-and-diamond emblem and ragged cloth character, readable but secondary to the humans. Highest flag point about y=37%, same combined feet/contact pivot at x=50%, y=82%. No other changes; no enormous standard; no text, scenery, extra figures, platforms or background. Preserve true alpha transparency.
notes: Three anonymous map mercenaries and the existing abstract sigil. Pole/cloth reduced to human scale; preserve historical v1. Pivot at center of the combined foot contacts.
